<!-- pr-reviewer: 8a93223d1847f8254b0902e812cb2ee49d7bb994 -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects posted G-code. I reviewed the trial merge with upstream main `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8` locally.

The calculation uses the selected setup's stock and work-offset origin. The post keeps the box half-width as a lower limit. Mill streams do not receive the new parameter. No UI files change.

Local results:

| Test suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| app: lathe_post_turn_radius | 3 | 1 |
| app: lathe_post_tormach | 7 | 1 |
| app: lathe_post_tormach_g30 | 4 | 0 |
| app: lathe_post_tormach_thread | 8 | 0 |
| app: lathe_post | 7 | 0 |
| app: lathe_cycle_exit | 6 | 0 |
| app: turning_stock_approach | 3 | 0 |
| post: recorded_streams | 12 | 0 |
| post: post_engine | 33 | 0 |
| post: lathe_post_refusals | 11 | 0 |

The selected app and post test targets built with `cargo test --no-run`. Clippy passed with `-D warnings` for all post targets and for the app library and seven selected test targets.

Clippy with app `--all-targets` could not complete. Unchanged upstream code in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106–107` has these errors:

```text
E0308: expected Option<WorkMaterial>, found WorkMaterial
E0063: missing fields stepdown and stepover in initializer of CuttingRow
```

That file is identical to upstream main. These errors are not findings against this PR. The quick-gate plan selected the full batch because the trial merge was not committed. I ran the relevant suites directly; I did not run the full batch.

Requested changes:

1. `crates/app/tests/lathe_post_turn_radius.rs:193`: replace the fixed line window with a check that follows the G30 approach and departure motion blocks. The new test fails at line 200 because `checked` stays zero. The program contains `G30`, `T0101`, `G97 S3000 M3`, `M8`, then `G0 X19`. The window stops before that X move. The program ends with a two-axis rapid, `M9`, `M5`, then `G30`. Thus the test checks no X-only move. Keep a check that proves the test examines the intended moves.
2. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/axial_drill_mm.nc:19` and `axial_drill_inch.nc:19`: update the expected departure after the maintainer accepts the change. The millimetre test expects `G0 X24` but produces `G0 X33.941`. An independent inch check expects `G0 X0.9449` but produces `G0 X1.3363`. Every other line matches. These values agree with the corner diameter of the 24 × 24 stock. The stale goldens leave `an_axial_drill_posts_as_plain_moves_in_mm_and_inch` red.

I checked all nine inherited golden diffs line by line. They are already in upstream main. This PR's remaining change does not update a golden.

Two mutation checks passed:

- Ignore the turning radius in `stockEnv()`: `the_g30_moves_use_the_square_bars_corner_circle` passed before the mutation, failed with it, and passed after restoration.
- Omit the parameter from `post::dump`: `a_lathe_stream_states_the_radius_its_stock_sweeps` passed before the mutation, failed with it, and passed after restoration.

All temporary changes were restored. No GitHub runner or real control was used. The PR is mergeable, but the two test failures prevent a clean review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
